title: Localized flat single comparison on a cartesian source
statement: Let $S,T,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U\subset S$, $V\subset U$ and $W\subset T$ open. Let $p:Y\to W$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, $M$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent] flat over $p$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], $g:V\to W$, $q:Z\to Y$ and $r:Z\to V$, with $(q,r,p,g)$ cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. Supply arbitrary derived localizations on $Y,W$ and the localized module site over $V$ [def-pc-derived-category]; use standard localizations on $Z,V$. For the inverse exact site equivalence $E$ over $V$ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], there is an isomorphism $E_D(Rr_*(q^*M)[0])\cong \operatorname{localizedMixedDerivedPullback}(U,V,W,g)(Rp_*M[0])$. Here $q^*$ is ordinary tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], the direct images are [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the mixed functor is [def-pc-localized-mixed-derived-pullback]. No morphism from another ambient scheme to S and no ambient coefficient F is given.

proof.text: Apply standard_flat_single_baseChange to p, M and g in standard localizations. Stalkwise flat tensor comparison and qcqs single-complex induction supply this geometric comparison.

Use sq.isoPullback to identify the given source with the canonical pullback. Use SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorPullbackIsEquivalence from IsoPullbackStalkCohomology: ordinary pullback along this isomorphism is an exact equivalence, so left-derived uniqueness computes it termwise. Derived pullback composition and adjunction identify its pushforward as inverse. Derived direct-image composition and ordinary single-pullback comparisons transport the result to q and r.

Use one functorial K-injective resolution of M[0] in supplied and standard localizations. Resolution computation and localization uniqueness identify the two direct images and their single objects. Apply the exact derived inverse overEquiv V to the cartesian comparison composed with derived pullback of the inverse localization comparison. The target is the mixed pullback by its definition.

theorem localized_cartesian_flat_single_comparison
    {S T Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (U : S.Opens) (V : U.toScheme.Opens) (W : T.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wW}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (p : Y ⟶ W.toScheme) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p)
    (g : V.toScheme ⟶ W.toScheme) (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : Z ⟶ V.toScheme)
    (sq : IsPullback q r p g) :
  let dV := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
  letI := dV
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))
  Nonempty ((@Functor.mapDerivedCategory _ _ _ dV _ _ _ _
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).inverse _ _ _).obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage r).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj q M))) ≅
    (localizedMixedDerivedPullback U V W g).obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)))
